<p>Database-friendly cohort analysis function.
A remake of <a href="https://github.com/PeerChristensen/cohorts">https://github.com/PeerChristensen/cohorts</a>, combining
<code>cohort_table_month</code>, <code>cohort_table_year</code>, and <code>cohort_table_day</code> into a single package.
Rewritten for database compatibility and tested with Snowflake and DuckDB.
</p>

## Usage

```r
cohort(.data, .date, .value, time_unit = "month", period_label = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-data"><code>.data</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-data"></a></dt>
<dd><p>tibble or dbi object</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-date"><code>.date</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-date"></a></dt>
<dd><p>date column</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-value"><code>.value</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-value"></a></dt>
<dd><p>id column</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-time-unit"><code>time_unit</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-time-unit"></a></dt>
<dd><p>do you want summarize the date column to 'day', 'week', 'month','quarter' or 'year'</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-period-label"><code>period_label</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-period-label"></a></dt>
<dd><p>do you want period labels or the dates c(TRUE , FALSE)</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>segment object
</p>

## Details

<ul>
<li>
<p> Groups your <code>.value</code> column by shared time attributes from the <code>.date</code> column.
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p> Assigns each member to a cohort based on their first entry in <code>.date</code>.
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p> Aggregates the cohort by the <code>time_unit</code> argument (<code>day</code>, <code>week</code>, <code>month</code>, <code>quarter</code>, or <code>year</code>).
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p> Computes the distinct count of each cohort member over time.
</p>
</li>
</ul>
